text: Aphasia (sensory): Ger. sensorische Aphasie ; Fr. aphasie sensorielle , Ital. afasia sensoriale , afasia del tipo Wernicke . Loss or impairment of the power to comprehend spoken or written language, either (1) purely sensory, as in PSYCHIC BLINDNESS or DEAFNESS (q.v.) for words, or (2) amnesic, due to impairment or loss of verbal memories other than muscular. Theoretically, it is independent of any defect of sensation or articulation. It is contrasted with motor aphasia, and has intimate and important relations to the other factors of language which are considered under SPEECH AND ITS DEFECTS (q.v.). ( J.J . - J.M.B .)
